d: This is not a musical. Milton Jones is tone deaf and has no sense of rhythm, but at least he doesn't make a song and dance about it. He has more important things to discuss. Like giraffes…and there's a bit about tomatoes. You might know him from Mock the Week, Live at the Apollo or Radio 4.
